measurement: source map ingest + fusion, end to end on a real build

real_build_run.fixture: bench/fixtures/artifacts/preact (preact@10.29.8 bundled by our esbuild config)
real_build_run.input: stats.json (12 modules, 1 asset 35 KB) + bundle.js.map + bundle.min.js.map

output.note: ground truth chosen because the maps cover 100 % of the declared bytes; the summary says so instead of echoing the requested dimension

targets.B5: ≤ 1 s for a 50 MB / 10k-source map: met at 46 ms (10k) and 209 ms (50k / 36.5 MB)
targets.B8: fusion memory < 500 MB on 1 GB stats + 50 MB map: partially met — 67 MB on the 36.5 MB map; the 1 GB stats + map combination is not yet measured together

bugs_found_by_own_tests.what: the first VLQ decoder split segments on ':' and produced an empty mapping list
bugs_found_by_own_tests.why_it_matters: source map segments pack all fields into one colon-free run ('IACE' = 4 values); field identity comes from position
bugs_found_by_own_tests.fix: positional field decoding with a shared segment decoder; tests now build mappings from a VLQ encoder so the intent is readable

bugs_found_by_own_tests.what: bytes after the last mapping were never attributed, so an inlined runtime showed as 0 bytes
bugs_found_by_own_tests.fix: attribute_by_source_in(generated_len) credits the tail to the last segment; the CLI passes the measured asset size

bugs_found_by_own_tests.what: two maps for the same sources (readable + minified) were merged into one table, double counting
bugs_found_by_own_tests.caught_by: the end-to-end run on the preact fixture
bugs_found_by_own_tests.fix: attribution is scoped per asset; modules are matched against the tables of the assets they belong to

bugs_found_by_own_tests.what: the summary printed the requested size dimension instead of the one used
bugs_found_by_own_tests.caught_by: reading the output against the contract (unified-graph.md §3)
bugs_found_by_own_tests.fix: the report states the dimension it used, with NPT0050 explaining an upgrade or downgrade
